question: v13
q: What's the jobless rate in the territory Canberra's in?

transcript.answer:
Canberra is in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT). Its unemployment rate was **4.7% in September 2026**, the latest month available (4.66% before rounding).

The ABS doesn't publish a seasonally adjusted figure for the ACT through this tool, so this is the original (unadjusted) series. It is volatile from month to month. The rate in 2026 so far:

| Month | Unemployment rate |
|---|---|
| Jan | 4.7% |
| Feb | 3.8% |
| Mar | 4.1% |
| Apr | 4.8% |
| May | 3.7% |
| Jun | 3.9% |
| Jul | 3.6% |
| Aug | 3.9% |
| Sep | 4.7% |

The rate has ranged from 3.6% to 4.8% this year. September's jump from August is partly noise, so it's better to read the figure as a range of roughly 4% than as a precise level.
